question: Will young characters like Petra, Meili, or Schult become adults by the end of the story, and how much taller did Petra get between Arc 4 and Arc 6?
answer:
The Royal Selection is set to last for 3 years, so Petra (who was 12 in Arc 4) will be 15 by the end—the same age Felt was at the start of the story. I love depicting the growth of children in fiction, like in the manga PSYREN, so their appearances will change (which gives Otsuka-sensei extra work!).

By Arc 6, Petra has definitely grown taller—girls often hit their growth spurts around 13 or 14, so she is taller than Beatrice now, around 150 cm or so. When Meili grows up, I think she will try to dress like Elsa. The Arlam village kids will all grow as well. As for Schult, he is designed as an adorable shota character, so I can't imagine how he'll turn out—we won't be able to call him Schult-chan then!
